title: The Useful tool for the trade
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：useful　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 useful 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the grandmother wrote of ① a useful tool for the trade in the diary, and everybody in the courtyard said at once that it was ② more useful than the one named there the year before. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the grandmother, who never explained anything, had done it in the rain and gone home; it was the useful ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most useful tool for the trade anybody in the courtyard had ever seen, or so the diary for February 1964 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too useful to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the useful ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the lamp at the far window, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a useful advice from the old man, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as useful as the advice from the old man they had once had in the old courtyard. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was useful or not, and he said so.

By 1977 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the diary. What the line asked for was ⑦ something useful, and nothing besides. The child from the next courtyard called the whole plan ⑧ quite useful; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the diary kept the names of the useful ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1980, without complaint, she wrote of another useful tool for the trade in the same diary, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ more useful than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most useful advice from the old man in the whole courtyard, she said in 1982, was the one she could never quite name; the useful ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有用（前置定语 a useful tool for the trade：1970 年祖母在日记里记下的那件有用的工具）
B. adj. 有用／实用（比较级 more useful than：文中两处，一处比这一行有用的工具，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有用／实用（最高级 the most useful：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有用（表语 too useful to do：母亲觉得它太有用，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 实用（前置定语 a useful advice from the old man：叔叔把整件事称作一桩实用的指点）
F. adj. 实用（同级比较 as useful as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩老人有用的指点相比）
G. adj. 实用（后置定语 something useful：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 实用（受程度副词修饰 quite useful：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: a useful tool for the trade
the most useful tool for the trade anybody
a useful advice from the old man
The most useful advice from the old man in

answers.why: useful 意为“有用”，1970 年祖母在日记里记下的是“一件有用的工具”，此处作前置定语 a useful tool for the trade。
useful 意为“有用”，此处用比较级 more useful than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
useful 意为“有用”，日记上 二月 那行字说它是院子里最有用的一件，故用最高级 the most useful tool for the trade。
useful 意为“有用”，母亲认为这件东西“太有用了，谁也用不上”，too useful to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
useful 意为“实用”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩实用的指点”，此处作前置定语 a useful advice from the old man。
useful 意为“实用”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩老人有用的指点一样实用”，同级比较用 as useful as。
useful 意为“实用”，日记上那半行字要的是“实用的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something useful。
useful 意为“实用”，邻院子来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当实用”，quite 修饰原级 useful。
useful 意为“实用”，1980 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要实用”，故用比较级 more useful than。
useful 意为“实用”，母亲 1982 年说的是“整个院子里最实用的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most useful advice from the old man。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，祖母在日记里记下了一件有用的工具。（a useful tool for the trade）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有用。（more useful than …）
母亲觉得它太有用，谁也用不上。（too useful to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩实用的指点。（a useful advice from the old man）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩老人有用的指点一样实用。（as useful as …）
到了 1977 年，日记上只剩半行字：要的是一件实用的东西。（something useful）
answers: In 1970 the grandmother wrote of a useful tool for the trade in the diary.
Everybody said it was more useful than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too useful to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a useful advice from the old man.
He said nobody would call it as useful as the advice from the old man they had once had.
By 1977 the diary asked for nothing but something useful.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 useful 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the grandmother wrote of a useful tool for the trade in the diary, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most useful tool for the trade in the courtyard, or so the diary says.
My mother thought it too useful to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a useful advice from the old man, and nobody argued with him.
The child from the next courtyard called the plan quite useful, and everybody laughed.
The useful ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
